about.title: Seal Beach Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Seal Beach is home to roughly 24,600 people, and a death here is felt across the whole town. In 2025 the city recorded 88 injury collisions and 3 traffic deaths, with public records showing crashes concentrated along I-405, Seal Beach Boulevard, and Pacific Coast Highway. Behind each number is a household working out what comes next. A wrongful death claim is a civil case, separate from anything prosecutors may pursue, and it belongs first to the spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. Families generally have two years from the date of death to file, and far less if a public agency is involved. Recoverable losses include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the person would have provided, and the love, companionship, and guidance no ledger can capture. LawProactive connects you with an independent Orange County attorney who takes these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Seal Beach Families Reach Out to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who may file
items.desc: California limits standing to the spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney you are connected with can sort out who in your family is eligible before anyone files.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: Most claims must be brought within two years of the date of death, and the window shrinks sharply when a city, county, or Caltrans is involved. Getting connected quickly protects that timeline.

items.title: Every loss accounted for
items.desc: Funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance can all be part of a claim. An independent attorney works on contingency, so you pay nothing unless there is a recovery.

items.question: A relative died in a crash on Pacific Coast Highway in Seal Beach. Does a shorter deadline apply?
items.answer: It might. PCH is a state route, and if the claim involves Caltrans or another public agency, California requires a government claim to be filed within months rather than years. Even if a private driver is the only party at fault, the general two-year deadline still runs from the date of death. An attorney can pin down which timeline applies to your situation.

items.question: The other driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action, and it can proceed regardless of what happens in the criminal court. The two cases have different goals and different standards of proof. Many families pursue both at the same time.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything to connect us with an attorney?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm. The independent attorneys in the network handle wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning no fee is owed unless there is a recovery. You can ask questions before deciding whether to move forward.
